desc:
!! This game is heavily inspired from Dumbfire !!

Lock in and become a rocket.. Blast through packed with enemy tanks, helicopters, planes.. Fuel is limited.. how far can you fly before you crash?

⚠️Warning⚠️This game is difficult and it might take time for you to get used to it. 

[IMPORTANT]: Make sure you check the settings tab from the top left topbar. You can customize your keybinds, mobile HUD customization and more.

THE GAME IS ON BETA. Keep in mind this game is still on active development and new updates will come out often. Make sure using feedback button.

CONTROLS:

Space / Click — FIRE
Mouse — Steer toward the crosshair
W / S — Nose down / up < (YOU CAN INVERT CONTROLS FROM SETTINGS TAB)
A / D — Turn left / right
B — Change camera perspective
Hold Space — Burn engine

Game supports; 📱Mobile, 🎮Console, 🖥️PC
